local_charge_fluxes.casimir_scope: M and Pi are central for compactly supported derivative-field observables
local_charge_fluxes.potential_algebra: {phi(x),Pi}=1; Pi is not central in the potential algebra

fixed_height_traveling_branch.consequence: At fixed M the classical traveling soliton has only the two velocity signs, not an open momentum interval

ring_zero_modes.decomposition: phi=Phi+M*x/L+phi_tilde, pi=Pi/L+pi_tilde, fixed M and zero-mean tilded fields
ring_zero_modes.symplectic_form: dPi wedge dPhi + integral d pi_tilde wedge d phi_tilde

positive_canonical_fock_polarization.Fourier_convention: phi(x)=sum_n phi_n exp(-i q_n x), q_n=2 pi n/L; phi_n^dagger=phi_-n and pi_n^dagger=pi_-n
positive_canonical_fock_polarization.annihilator: b_n=sqrt(L/(2 hbar)) [sqrt(omega_n) phi_n+i pi_n/sqrt(omega_n)], n nonzero
positive_canonical_fock_polarization.independence: b_n and b_-n are independent annihilation modes, not adjoints
positive_canonical_fock_polarization.quadratic_Hamiltonian: H2=sum_(n nonzero) hbar omega_n (b_n^dagger b_n+1/2), with a finite mode cutoff before vacuum subtraction
positive_canonical_fock_polarization.target_modes: U_n=(3i q_n/2) phi_n, V_n=sqrt(3) pi_n/4 for n nonzero
positive_canonical_fock_polarization.highest_weight_conflict: U_n|0>=V_n|0>=0 for n>0 would require both b_n|0>=0 and b_-n^dagger|0>=0, impossible for a nonzero positive-norm vector
positive_canonical_fock_polarization.scope: Explicit positive canonical algebra and free-vacuum Fock space. Realization of contracted T/Q operators, renormalized interaction and interacting soliton states remains unconstructed.

soliton_fourier_transform.formula: u_hat(q)=2 pi q/sinh(pi q/k), pi_hat(q)=-v u_hat(q)

finite_ring.common_charge_sector: M=Pi=0 after uniform compensation of each periodized profile
finite_ring.interpretation: A log L divergence survives in a common compensated periodic oscillator space

translation_control.interpretation: Translation at fixed charges has finite infrared coherent occupation

compensating_cloud.fields: u_c=Delta_M w((x-R)/L)/L, pi_c=Delta_Pi w((x-R)/L)/L, integral w=1
compensating_cloud.scaling: M_c and Pi_c stay fixed, H_c=O(1/L), P_c=O(1/L); spatial separation removes soliton-cloud cross terms

failures_recorded: The tentative identification of the bare traveling-wave family with an open momentum branch at fixed kink height fails: M=2k fixes k.
The tentative inference that an arbitrarily low-energy compensating background is harmless to the Fock-state limit fails: the occupation diverges logarithmically with box length.
No Python assertion failed during the implementation and no numerical tolerance was weakened.
limitations: These are exact Gaussian-vacuum and classical phase-space diagnostics, not a construction of interacting quantum solitons.
The divergent free coherent norm does not prove that an interacting dressed S-matrix or stable soliton state cannot exist.
The finite-ring profile uses exact periodization and a uniform charge compensation; it is initial data, not an exact periodic nonlinear traveling solution.
A fixed total charge sector can accommodate a varying local soliton profile with a soft cloud. Its interacting asymptotic evolution and scattering normalization remain to be derived.
No claim about quantum decay, exact factorization, or a physical infraparticle exponent is made.
